candidate.description:
Dishaank enables citizens to easily identify the survey number of any location within Karnataka using mobile GPS.
The app also allows citizens to access detailed land information, including ownership, survey boundaries and Hissa boundaries.

Developed by the Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC), Dishaank promotes transparency and simplifies access to land records across the state.

Key Features:
* Identify survey/Hissa numbers using your current GPS location
* View land ownership details
* Legend view for map description
* Search by district, taluk, hobli, village, and survey number
* Weather widget: tap any location to view current weather and 3-day forecast
* Measurement tools to calculate land area and distances
* Go to latitude/longitude function for precise location navigation
* Simple and user-friendly map interface

Disclaimer:
Data provided in Dishaank is for information purposes only and not legally valid for ownership or boundary confirmation.

Kaveri SeQR Scan is a QR & 1D barcode scanner application that can be used for a broad range of document verification purposes. It is capable of reading encrypted QR codes and 1D barcodes printed on official educational documents issued by Kaveri University.

The system, known as SeQR Documents, generates secure educational documents using a combination of advanced security algorithms. These algorithms create encrypted QR codes and unique security features that help prevent duplication and forgery of official documents.

Not only authorized issuers of the documents can scan and retrieve certificate details, but public users can also register for free and perform document verification where permitted.

After scanning, the application displays a preview of the certificate along with other document details, allowing users to compare the information with the physical document. This makes verification of Kaveri University documents quick, secure, free, and easy through the Kaveri SeQR Scan application.

candidate.description:
Welcome to Congo Kinshasa! 



In the massive land many know as „The Democratic Republic of the Congo”, a township called Uvira is home to farmers, clergy, students, children, engineers, rogues, heroes and many more. Come along on a tragicomic role-playing adventure in which you volunteer for the local chapter of „Happy Club International”, an NGO where not all is as it seems!





To complete your program with Happy Club International, you have to find four local inhabitants of Uvira and make them find true happiness...but the road to perfect bliss isn't a straight path or a garden of roses! 





Complete four different chapters, one for each of your clients you'll lead on the road to true happiness! Venture into the real Congo with hand-drawn RPG worlds inspired by Uvira in real life, and consulted on with local students, farmers and educators! 





Explore farms, caverns, mountaintops, volcanoes, churches, marketplaces, residences, lakes, beaches, forests, villages and even a big city! 

You may encounter some foes along the way, be they pests, recalcitrant children, a monkey with a bucket on its head, spirits from Central Africa's history throughout the ages or even the demons inside your very soul...but never fear! The Kaverini combat system is back, complete with fourteen emotional techniques you can use to disarm your foes, no violence required! 





The various foes don't just offer „combat damage” in this game, they'll also offer you challenges that will make you rethink your life choices, essay prompts, ask for help from people who aren't playing the game and even give you a karaoke track to sing!





- Be Anything, Do Anything, Go Anywhere! This time...to Congo Kinshasa!




- You can draw your own character by linking up your phone to a computer via USB, or use one of the twenty pre-drawn characters!





- Choose a pet to accompany you on your journey from the DRC's legendary fauna! You can draw your own pet in the game files as well!




- Four different overarching missions of ten levels each, in which you lead a Congolese local to true happiness! Each chapter offers your client as a companion that gives you a different bonus!




- Customize your non-violent play style by choosing and leveling up your emotional techniques!




- Lovely items based on Congolese cuisine to heal you! Fufu, banana beer, mikate or classic rice and beans...what do you feel like today?



- Different locations in the game may impact the fight in many different ways! In a field? On the beach? In a house? The outcome may look very different in each one!




- All information in this game has been fact-checked by inhabitants of Uvira, Bukavu and elsewhere in the DRC!

Eräkaveri answers one question: is it worth going, where – and when? One map-based app that brings together the conditions for a fishing trip, a hike, the berry woods, the mushroom forest, a birding outing, the northern lights and the ski tracks.

FISHING
• Bite forecast: the best hours of the day based on weather, pressure, wind and water temperature.
• Fishing guide: lure tips and conditions coaching for the species you choose.
• Depth contours and Best Spots on the map, water temperature and flow.
• Area restrictions and a modelled ice assessment.

HIKING AND MOUNTAIN BIKING
• Trails and trail conditions — length, elevation profile and services along the route.
• Suggestions for where to go today and cards for places out in the terrain.

BERRIES AND MUSHROOMS
• Growing-site assessments from forest data as coloured zones.
• Picking conditions and a harvest log.

NORTHERN LIGHTS
• Aurora forecast by the hour for the next two nights: the best moment with its date and time
• Tonight's cloud cover hour by hour – a clear sky decides more often than activity does
• Geomagnetic activity (NOAA Kp) and the threshold your own location needs
• Rest spots on the map for picking a viewing place

BIRDS
• Recent bird observations on the map and species lists — where to find which species.

SKIING
• Ski track network and skiing conditions.

YOUR PLACES AND TRACKS
• Save places, log catches and harvests, record and export a GPS track.

COVERAGE
The content and the data sources cover Finland.

IMPORTANT
The forecasts, growing-site assessments and the ice assessment are models, not measurements or guarantees. They describe what the environment is like – not what you will find there. Depth data is not suitable for navigation.

DATA SOURCES
The open data sources (including the Finnish Meteorological Institute, the Finnish Environment Institute, the National Land Survey of Finland, the Finnish Forest Centre, Traficom, Metsähallitus, Lipas and GBIF) are credited in the app's About view in line with their licence terms.

SUBSCRIPTION
Eräkaveri is a paid subscription app. New users get a 7-day free trial, after which the subscription continues automatically on the plan you choose, monthly or yearly. The price for your region is shown in the App Store and in the app before you confirm the purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours of the end of that period. You can manage and cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused part of the trial is forfeited if you buy the subscription during the trial.

candidate.description:
Walli tells you when you're paying more for being a woman, and shows the math behind it.

The "pink tax" isn't an official tax. It's the price gap between products marketed to women and their near-identical counterparts marketed to men: razors, shampoo, clothing, and dozens of other everyday categories. Walli exists to make that gap visible, and to help you do something about it.

PINK TAX RADAR
Enter any product and its price. Walli cross-references it against real market data and returns a clear verdict: Good Deal, Fair, or Overpriced, along with the exact price gap in your own currency. No vague warnings, no guesswork. Every verdict is backed by a documented category-level markup study, not an AI estimate.

WALLI INDEX
Every scan you run feeds a live, crowdsourced dataset tracking pink tax markups by category, country, and continent. Browse real submission counts and average markups from around the world, updated as the community scans. It's the clearest public picture of where, and how badly, the pink tax shows up globally.

FINANCIAL HEALTH SCORE
Your score is calculated transparently from your own logged income, expenses, and savings goals. Every point is traceable: see exactly what's helping your score and what isn't, with no hidden formula and no assumptions about your life.

GOALS BOARD
Set a savings target, log your progress, and track it in real time. No spreadsheets, no manual math.

MONEY SCHOOL
Short, jargon-free lessons on the financial concepts that actually matter: budgeting, credit, investing, salary negotiation, and more. Built for anyone who was never formally taught this in school.

PRIVACY, BY DESIGN
Walli doesn't require an account, doesn't collect personal information, and doesn't track you across other apps or websites. The only data shared is what you choose to submit to the Pink Tax Radar, and that becomes part of the public, anonymous Walli Index. Full details are available in our in-app privacy policy.

Walli is built by Kaia Roy, Founder of Aurea Global Network, an initiative dedicated to building tools that make financial fairness visible, measurable, and actionable.

candidate.description:
No Niin is a social debt ledger for Finns. It tracks what you owe your friends — not in euros, but in real things.

Fazer bars. Lonkeros. Kotipizza. Hesburgers. Kyrö whisky. This is how Finnish friendships are measured.

Every person gets a jar. The jar fills up as debts accumulate. Amber means you owe. Green means they owe you. Finland is watching.

HOW IT WORKS

Tap + to record a debt. Choose who bought what for whom, pick the item, set the quantity. Tap Record & Share — a message is ready to send, because a debt unacknowledged is a debt disputed.

When the time is right, open the jar and tap Settle Up. The jar empties. Finland is in balance.

FINNISH UNITS

No Niin uses social units instead of money. Because "you owe me a lonkero" is a social contract. "You owe me €4.50" is an invoice.

Units: Fazer Bar · Paulig Coffee · R-Kioski Coffee · Jaffa · Lonkero · Koff · Hesburger · Lapin Kulta 6-pack · Kotipizza · Kyrö Whisky

FEATURES

— Sign in with Apple. No passwords.
— Send a debt message directly via iMessage or WhatsApp.
— Find friends by phone number even if they don't have the app yet.
— Automatic debt netting — if both sides owe each other, the balance collapses automatically.
— Dispute a debt if you believe it unjust. It will be noted. It will be brought up at the next sauna gathering. There's a story here.

The jar doesn't lie. Your memory might.

"A debt is a brother when taken, a nephew when repaid." — Finnish proverb
